name: Enum Picker
summary: Ask the client to render a single-selection picker from a bounded set of options and return the selected value to the agent.

invocation.notes: The payload supplies the bounded choices needed for the interaction. The client owns visual presentation and control implementation.

outcomes.name: Selected
outcomes.summary: The person selected one of the supplied bounded options.

outcomes.name: Canceled
outcomes.summary: The person dismissed the picker without choosing a value.

outcomes.name: Failed
outcomes.summary: The client could not complete the picker interaction.

responseContract.notes: The selected option value is returned as a string Scalar. The client must return a value from the bounded options supplied for the interaction.

sourceReferences.note: Defines bounded Client Interaction payload and response contracts.
Identified a reusable picker sourced from a bounded enum as the next Client Directive primitive.
